title: Internal: handling procedure for recording a Personal Training Packages refund
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member's package is being refunded for its unused sessions, the agent records the refund of the package's unused-session value. This applies within the eligibility this product's refund-window documents already state, and additionally only once the package's trainer-of-record is reconciled with the trainer most recently named on that package's own reassignment history.

## Prerequisite
This document states as a general clause that the package's trainer-of-record must match the trainer named on the most recent trainer-reassignment record for the package, wherever at least one such record exists, before this refund may be recorded. Where the two disagree, the trainer-of-record does not yet reconcile with that record, and the refund is not recorded on the package until it does.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): record_package_refund_4aaf76ef.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package being refunded, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- refund_amount_usd: the total amount to refund, in US dollars, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places, passed as the full computed refund amount.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number and the amount refunded; the presence of a new reference number indicates the refund was recorded successfully, and the package's session balance is zeroed out to reflect that no further sessions remain to redeem. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
